intro: Each newsletter is a sequence of sentences projected into a two-dimensional style space derived from linguistic features. The axes are principal components fit on sentence-level measurements across all posts; only the stable 2D subspace is shown.

sections.label: style generalization
sections.description: Cross-newsletter variance accounted for (VAF): how well one newsletter's style subspace explains another's sentence variation. Syntactic features vs. SBERT semantic embeddings (384-dim) vs. random baseline. Higher = more shared structure.

sections.label: subspace stability
sections.description: Principal angle between the full-sample subspace and 250 bootstrap-resampled subspaces. Top-2 is stable; top-3 is not. We stay in 2D to represent the newsletters.
